note: FNS 1152.1 requires QC reviewers to document property tax details (types, amounts, time periods, verification, mortgage inclusion, variances). The OLG covers the underlying policy elements comprehensively. The 'Shelter Expenses Deduction' page explicitly lists 'real estate taxes' as an allowable shelter expense within the mortgage definition, and separately states that 'Charges for property taxes, home insurance, and/or any other fees that are not included the mortgage must be added to the shelter costs' (How SNAP Benefits are Calculated). The 'Verification of Shelter Expenses' section lists 'current property tax bills' as acceptable verification. BEACON data entry procedures capture expense type, amount, and frequency (with dropdown for weekly/monthly/quarterly etc.), addressing the time-period element. The Non-Recurring Medical Expenses page even provides an example of converting quarterly taxes to monthly ($300/3). The variance-explanation requirement is QC-specific and has no caseworker equivalent. All substantive policy elements are covered.
